# Codenest

> Codenest is a UK consultancy for startup founders. It provides a Fractional CTO and a Fractional CFO, from pre-seed to Series A. Founders take one seat or both; with both, the technical roadmap and the financial model are built together.

Two principals, two seats:

- Ankit Rana is the Fractional CTO: 15+ years in engineering leadership, covering architecture, agentic AI engineering, hiring and technical due diligence.
- Michelle Rana FCCA is the Fractional CFO: a chartered accountant who led strategic finance at a multi-site business through growth from £35m to £165m revenue. She covers financial strategy, modelling, fundraising and investor reporting.

Their track records are separate and should not be attributed to each other. Codenest does not publish prices. Engagements start with a free 30-minute strategy call.

## Services

- [Fractional CTO](https://codenest.uk/services/fractional-cto/): technical leadership for pre-seed and seed startups, covering architecture, AI engineering, hiring and due diligence preparation
- [Fractional CFO](https://codenest.uk/services/fractional-cfo/): financial strategy, modelling, fundraising and reporting, pre-seed to Series A
- [Which seat do you need?](https://codenest.uk/services/): how to choose between the Fractional CTO, the Fractional CFO, or both

## Guides

- [What is a fractional CFO?](https://codenest.uk/guides/fractional-cfo-guide/): role, when to hire, UK costs, and how it differs from an accountant
- [What is a fractional CTO?](https://codenest.uk/guides/fractional-cto-guide/): role, when you need one, costs, and how to choose
- [Series A due diligence](https://codenest.uk/guides/series-a-due-diligence/): what investors check on the technology and the finances, and the cross-checks between them
- [Fractional CFO vs full-time CFO](https://codenest.uk/guides/fractional-cfo-vs-full-time/): year-one cost, equity and timing
- [Fractional CTO vs full-time CTO](https://codenest.uk/guides/fractional-cto-vs-full-time/): cost, equity and trade-offs by stage
- [Fractional CFO vs outsourced finance](https://codenest.uk/guides/fractional-cfo-vs-outsourced-finance/): judgement versus processing, and why most startups use both
- [Fractional CTO vs development agency](https://codenest.uk/guides/fractional-cto-vs-agency/): strategy versus execution
- [Technical co-founder alternatives](https://codenest.uk/guides/technical-cofounder-alternatives/): the options when no co-founder is available

## Tools

- [Startup runway calculator](https://codenest.uk/tools/runway-calculator/): months of runway from cash, burn and revenue growth
- [Technical due diligence readiness check](https://codenest.uk/tools/technical-due-diligence-check/): 25 statements across seven areas investors examine, scored in the browser
